title: Python TOFU capacity can evict peers with active fragmentation state
description: LinkLayer.receive chooses a full-pin-table victim solely by transient _generation_leases. Long-lived SchcSessionManager sender/tombstone and authenticated reassembly context/tombstone lifetimes do not hold those leases, so a 65th authenticated peer can evict a peer with an active or hold-down-protected fragmentation tuple. That violates the spec's no-active-context eviction rule and can abort/cross-contaminate transfers. Pin eviction eligibility must also exclude any signer occupied in sender/reassembly sessions, tombstones, rejections, pending verified controls/DIO transaction state; reject atomically if no safe victim. Add active inbound/outbound/tombstone saturation and post-expiry admission tests.
